basis: The v2 acceptance gates and 1 November continuation prompt, with a predeclared Development-only setup-group split. No acceptance criteria have been lowered or changed.

versioning.changeRule: Any change to criteria, supported scope, candidate configuration, or split after evaluation starts requires a new version. Preserve this version, assignments, failures, and reports. Holdout feedback used for tuning permanently converts that exposed set to Development and requires a new session-separated Holdout.
versioning.holdoutRule: Do not open Holdout detector scores until labels, group assignments, candidate configuration, and this protocol are frozen.
versioning.holdoutExposure: None; no Holdout labels or scores have been opened. v3 planned groups are Development train/validation only.
versioning.splitChangeReason: v2 had one correlated validation setup group. v3 predeclares 12 new Development layouts with three planned groups in every role-by-light cell; the post-capture exporter must still verify transitive session and setup isolation. Planned coverage is not collected evidence.

scope.product: Android phone Live Detect on Pixel 11 using the mounted camera and canonical SkyEye.GameState review path.
included: Fresh settled inventory and conservative unknown state
Phone resource and one-action interaction gates
Physical shot events, bounded clips, and canonical review
conditionsOutsideSupportedScope: Lighting too dark for ordinary play
Unverified camera pose, table geometry, or source clock mapping

lightingStrata.definition: Normal bright pool-room lighting used for ordinary play. Record measured illuminance at the table, colour-temperature/source description, exposure state, and direct glare for every session.

Warm or dimmer pool-room lighting that remains suitable for ordinary play. Record measured illuminance at the table, colour-temperature/source description, exposure state, and direct glare for every session.

layoutCoverage: Reviewed reduced layouts with intentional cue or black absence
Balls near each pocket and cushion, including a visible black near the lower-left pocket with a nearby non-overlapping cue
Close or touching balls and other-colour balls over pocket mouths
Empty pocket mouths, rail/chalk/shadow negatives, and an overlapping/occluded cluster whose hidden centres remain unknown
supportedConditions.lightingAndLayoutRules: Keep camera, calibration, source settings, lighting, and non-target balls fixed within each matched pair. Record actual lighting and all changes. Do not use too-dark-to-play conditions as a supported stratum.

spatialLayouts.rule: Only independently reviewed visible centres and reviewed absence locations score spatial accuracy. Do not copy labels between frames. Preserve source pixels and source-coordinate labels.

split.unit: Whole recording session and every related setup/control group, including camera restarts and layout changes.
split.development: At least two to three distinct matched Development groups; both positive and negative controls on the same side of the split.
split.holdout: At least five distinct layouts in at least two separate held-out recording sessions, with matched positive and negative controls in each lighting stratum.
split.frame978: Development only. It cannot enter Holdout or be counted as a matched control.

requestWindows.denominator: Every predeclared request in the supported clear/still condition, including timeout, retry, required correction, unresolved output, and incorrect Ready.
requestWindows.correlation: Report session and stratum denominators and failures. Non-overlap does not make same-session requests statistically independent; include session-level uncertainty and do not claim more independent evidence than collected.

categories: Unexplained appearance or disappearance and occlusion
Camera nudge, source disconnect/reconnect, authority loss, and cancellation
unsafeWindows.rule: All categories must be represented. Count false Ready against the complete held-out denominator; the pass limit is zero.

corpusAndSampling.unchangedTableSoak: At least 30 seconds of repeated verification per representative layout. Retain every request, result, and source interval.

sourceImage.axes: x increases right and y increases down; source pixel centres are normalized as x/width and y/height.
sourceImage.tableCoordinates: The existing TableCalibration maps ordered corners to (0,0), (2,0), (2,1), and (0,1). Preserve source labels and record forward and inverse transforms, calibration provenance, and both source and table coordinate units.

accuracy.metric: Euclidean centre error in table-2x1 coordinates divided by the mapped labelled ball radius. Report per-frame, per-ball, per-session, per-lighting-stratum, and aggregate results, including worst error and pocket/cushion cases.
accuracy.percentile: Nearest-rank empirical 95th percentile over independently reviewed visible ball centres.
accuracy.labelPrecisionRule: A scored centre label must have independently reviewed uncertainty no greater than 0.00675 table units. Refine labels that exceed this bound before freezing the accuracy set. A cloth homography and image-centre review do not by themselves prove physical cloth-plane centre accuracy; audit sphere-height/parallax before making that claim.
accuracy.transformChecks: Verify the mapped source-image overlay, round-trip centres, exact dimensions, corner order, source hash, and calibration provenance before scoring. Reject an unverified transform.

frame978DevelopmentBaseline.purpose: Explicit tolerance for the single Development baseline score only; it is approximately 0.37 of the labelled radius and is not the accepted accuracy bound.
frame978DevelopmentBaseline.accuracyClaim: The current rough 4-7 source-pixel review uncertainty exceeds the 0.25R proposal for some frame 978 centres. This frame cannot establish the p95 accuracy gate without label refinement.

correctTimelyLayout.start: Monotonic time when the phone accepts the user's Live Detect request.
correctTimelyLayout.end: First publication of a fresh, settled, clear, exact reviewed inventory with all required evidence and no unresolved reason.
failureCases: Unresolved/uncertain result in a supported clear/still request
Incorrect count, identity, colour, or centre
correctTimelyLayout.inventoryRule: Full-rack windows require exactly 16 unique correctly classified balls: one cue, seven reds, seven yellows, and one black. A reduced layout is eligible only with independently reviewed/history-supported absence or accepted correction; unexplained missing cue/black, occlusion, or uncertain geometry remains unknown and cannot be Ready.

unsafeReadiness.rule: Any false Ready in a predeclared unsafe/source/control window fails this gate. Do not reclassify failed windows after evaluation.

unchangedTable.rule: No false movement, pot, return, re-rack, or count/colour change in published Ready results. Unknown during unsafe intervals is the expected safe result.

timingAndFreshness.analysisProcessingInterval: From analyzer start on an admitted frame through final analysis result for that same frame. Include both passes when the 800-to-1000 fallback occurs; report branch frequency.
timingAndFreshness.sourceAgeInterval: Mapped camera source capture time to publication decision for the same frame. Report clock-mapping age and uncertainty separately; do not add processing time to a post-analysis frame-age value.

verificationEvidence.sourceRule: Scoped frame IDs and source PTS must strictly increase. Duplicate/frozen frames, mapping failure, interrupted spans, or excessive gaps cannot establish Ready.

timingAndFreshness.reporting: Report acquisition/decode, analysis, publication, request-to-ready, and source age as distinct same-frame intervals. Show p50, p95, maxima, sample counts, percentile definitions, fallback counts, and failed windows; do not add independent percentiles.

phoneResourceAndInteraction.baseline: Matched Pixel 11 phone-only scenario at actual mounted-camera resolution, same source, calibration, lighting, session group, and warm-up policy.
otherLimits: No new playback stall longer than 1000ms
No monotonic retained native-resource growth after warm-up and repeated checks
One active/latest analysis owner with bounded work and prompt cancellation/disposal
phoneResourceAndInteraction.interaction: One actual phone tap produces a result or a specific reason without a timed second tap or separate ball-confirmation tap. Preset/select/clear actions do not increase detector calls. Exercise touch-origin and Sky-origin typed command parity where in scope.
phoneResourceAndInteraction.excluded: TV/Cast resource comparison and voice acceptance remain outstanding for broader release.

clipWindow.startAllowance: 0 <= requestedStartUs - RecordingOrigin.StartUs <= the maximum segment/keyframe interval verified from segment metadata and decoded first-frame evidence for this recording path.
clipWindow.endCoverage: Decoded content covers the requested end; separately record and enforce a predeclared 100ms frame/source-clock tolerance.
clipWindow.integrity: Verify same-timeline requested windows, decoded content, keyframe effects, actual coverage, finalization, and one-to-one event/activity linkage. A later start, missing history, excessive lead-in, missing post-roll, or merged distinct shots fails.

expectedCanonicalOrder: SettledInventoryAcceptedEvent or SettledInventoryCorrectedEvent after explicit review
SettledBaselineEstablishedEvent when a new trusted baseline is warranted
SettledInventoryAcceptedEvent or SettledBaselineEstablishedEvent only after complete re-verification
Two distinct ShotStartedEvent/ShotEndedEvent/TableSettledEvent/ShotResolvedEvent sequences in source-time order
one queued clip request remains attributable through stop
unknown if required source post-roll is interrupted
activities.interruptionRule: Stopping Live Detect must preserve the queued save while the camera source remains available through the required post-roll. If source continuity is interrupted, record exactly one linked incomplete/unknown outcome, count the eligible clip gate as failed, and do not infer pot/no-pot.

physicalEventAndClipGate.review: For each planned activity, retain before/after inventories and source-aligned movement, settle, and event PTS. Review through ReviewLiveOutcomeAsync and the existing canonical SkyEye.GameState path; accepted facts and canonical state must agree. Preserve every attempt, repeat, missing/duplicate event, timeout, failed save, ambiguity, and interruption.

gateStatus.completionRule: All three gates must pass on the tested current implementation and installed package, with linked evidence binding this contract, corpus/split lock, source/artifact hashes, analyzer configuration, tested commit, installed APK, and all failures/exclusions.
